name: Douglas N. Masters
tagline: Top rated Intellectual Property attorney in Chicago, Illinois
about: Douglas N. Masters is an attorney who represents clients in the Chicago, Illinois area. Douglas Masters is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2013 - 2027. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Douglas Masters chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended Harvard Law School and graduated in 1988. Douglas Masters passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 1988.
He represents clients with Intellectual Property issues in Illinois. He also represents clients with Intellectual Property Litigation and Media and Advertising issues.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, Douglas Masters has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
